scope: Domestic Brazil only. Polling sections, not buildings or unique physical machines.

definitions.time: Machine clocks normalized to Brasilia, UTC-3. Exact-second cutoff; before is strictly <, at/after is >=.
definitions.closing: Final VOTA Procedimento de encerramento confirmado event; checked against the published official bulletin dataHoraEncerramento. This precedes staff registration and BU generation and is not itself proof of irreversible completion.
definitions.buEmitted: Published official bulletin dataHoraEmissao. A bulletin already emitted is stronger evidence of completed local tallying than a closing confirmation.
definitions.candidateComparison: Full-day candidate totals in the identified polling sections, never candidate votes by time or an estimate of which candidate benefited from the extension.
definitions.unclassified: 70 clock-discontinuous logs, four logs lacking the closing confirmation, two unpublished domestic logs. Their votes remain in the official accounting.
definitions.bulletinClosing: Official BU dataHoraEncerramento, normalized to Brasilia. All closing comparisons in this public report use this field, not the nearby log-message timestamp. Includes four sections whose logs lack the confirmation event but whose clock traces have no detected discontinuity.
definitions.bulletinClockCoverage: 497,825 classifiable domestic BUs; 70 logs with detected clock discontinuities and two sections with no published logs are excluded from cutoff comparisons. All 497,897 domestic BUs remain in candidate and total-ballot reconciliation.

limitations: A session not yet formally closed may have stopped admitting voters. Closing times and ballot times do not reveal queue eligibility, the time officials learned of an order, or their motives.
After-17 ballots cannot all be attributed to the extension; voters already in line were ordinarily entitled to finish.
Candidate preferences of late voters cannot be inferred from the full-day results of their sections.
Clock backsteps are screened; machine clocks are not independently certified against an external time standard. Digital signature envelopes have not been independently verified.

reconciliation.method: National minus overseas, checked against all domestic official BUs.
